answer_1.quote: We select toxicity detection in natural language generation as the base task. The goal of this task is to detect if the generated text is toxic using a toxicity classifier.

answer_2.quote: There is a growing trend towards utilizing model-based metrics for evaluation purposes. Model-based metrics evaluate the outputs of an NLP model using another machine learning model such as using toxicity classifier to evaluate the toxicity of the generated texts by a text generation model...
automatic_metrics: model-based metrics with precision and false omission rate

answer_4.quote: We estimate precision and false omission rate (FOR) of this classifier on the manually annotated test set from ToxiGen.
answer_4.guideline: The metric model's performance (precision and false omission rate) is estimated on manually annotated data.
